The workbook's statistics calculations are failing with #NAME? errors, indicating unrecognized function names or invalid formula references.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed in /tests/test_outputs.py due to an AssertionError in assert_matrix. Multiple cells in the 'Task' worksheet (H46, I46, J46, K46, L46, H47, I47, J47, K47, L47) returned '#NAME?' instead of the expected floating-point statistical values. This error typically occurs when Excel or the processing library cannot resolve a function name or a named range used in the cell formulas.
